records.name: Dageno AI 2.0
records.tagline: See why AI recommends your competitors instead of you
records.description: AI is now choosing brands for your customers. Dageno AI is an AEO/GEO platform that shows whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and 7 more AI models recommend you or your competitors, and which sources drive those answers. Look up any market for free, forever: see top brands, buyer questions and cited sources across 12,000+ niche markets and 3M+ brands. Upgrade only when you need to track your own prompts. Built for brands and agencies.

records.name: Cardboard AI
records.tagline: Best way to edit videos with AI
records.description: Cardboard is an AI video editor that turns your raw clips into stories. Think of it as a creative collaborator that understands your footage, has taste to know what makes a great edit, and brings your vision to life.

records.name: Higgsfield Miracle
records.tagline: Edit any part of a video without changing the rest
records.description: Higgsfield Miracle vectorizes any video into layers for localized, pixel-level editing in real time, with world knowledge built in. Recolor objects, change backgrounds, remove or add elements, adjust lighting, and modify textures while preserving the original motion, camera, and subjects.

records.name: ProtoMap
records.tagline: Stop wasting AI tokens rediscovering dependencies
records.description: ProtoMap helps engineers and AI coding agents understand how services, APIs, and data fields depend on each other across large codebases. It builds a deterministic dependency map for gRPC and Protobuf systems, updated on every commit and accessible through a web app or MCP. Instead of wasting time and tokens searching code across repositories, agents query ProtoMap directly to understand change impact. One enterprise team reduced change-planning time and tokens by 8×.

records.name: Egoist AI Passport
records.tagline: Secure and share your personal data with AI tools.
records.description: AI Passport securely saves your personal data in one place, then lets you bring that context into the AI tools you use. Connect apps like Email, Calendar, ChatGPT, Claude, and more, choose exactly what data you want to share, and what you want to keep private, and revoke permissions whenever you want. Your AI tools get more personal, while your data stays yours.

records.name: Terse - Durable Actors
records.tagline: Infrastructure for Multiplayer AI Products
records.description: We provide an army of tiny servers to help you build incredible and cost efficient Multiplayer AI at scale. It's an open source alternative to Cloudflare's Durable Objects. Each resource or agent gets it's own micro-vm with a co-located SQLite DB. It can only process one request at a time making it concurrency safe. Onboard each one, is a websocket server. Allowing clients of any form to connect and listen for events on the resource.

records.name: Flic Cue
records.tagline: The AI Voice Button: hold to talk, shake to undo, open SDKs
records.description: Get your thoughts out of your head and into the right place, without picking up your phone or touching the keyboard. Say it, and Cue files it in your lists, calendar, notes or reminders, or hands bigger jobs to ChatGPT, Claude or your own agent. At your computer, what you say is typed in for you. Shake Cue to undo, swipe it right to copy the text instead, and give your coding agent its next instruction by voice. You decide what each push, swipe and shake does.

records.name: Watchflows
records.tagline: Visual automation for your Mac, with AI built in
records.description: Stop doing the same Mac chores by hand. Watchflows runs them the moment something happens: a file lands in Downloads, you press a hotkey, a webhook arrives, it's 8:30 on a weekday. Wire triggers, conditions, actions and AI on a canvas, or describe it in plain English and the Flow Builder assembles it. AI reads, renames and decides mid-flow, on Watchflows AI, Apple's on-device model, Ollama, or your own keys. Local-first, no account. 14-day free trial, then $49 once. Also on Setapp.

records.name: If You Read This
records.tagline: A daily check-in app that works like a dead man's switch
records.description: A daily check-in app that works like a dead man's switch. You check in by opening the app. If you miss your check-in and its reminders, your pre-written message is texted to the contacts you chose. For US and Canadian phone numbers.

records.name: Jotform App for Shopify
records.tagline: Build powerful forms for your Shopify store
records.description: Bring Jotform’s powerful forms to your Shopify store. Create contact forms, lead forms, applications, registrations, surveys, and more. Match your store’s style, add conditional logic, calculations, and file uploads, and connect responses to the tools your team uses. Manage forms and submissions in Jotform, with your store as another place to reach customers.

records.name: MCP1
records.tagline: One URL for every MCP server.
records.description: Connect and manage all your MCP servers through a single gateway. Built by Appwrite, MCP1 lets you securely connect your AI tools, manage permissions, protect server credentials, and monitor tool usage. Works with Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex, and more. Free for individuals, with dedicated plans for teams and enterprises.

records.name: GitHub New PR Overview
records.tagline: See what's blocking a PR before you scroll
records.description: GitHub's new pull request overview page moves merge status to the top, with checks, approvals, comments, and next actions in one compact summary. It also adds unresolved-comment filters, newest-first sorting, and an activity panel.

records.name: CozyZip
records.tagline: Zip and unzip without the surprises.
records.description: Preview, create and extract archives on your Mac, in Terminal or through local MCP tools. Free lifetime personal licence with verified email. Commercial use is US$5 once per person on up to three Macs. macOS 26+, Apple Silicon.

records.name: Sign Language by Panda Video
records.tagline: Add a sign language interpreter to videos already online
records.description: Upload a video of your sign language interpreter and link it to any video you've already published. Viewers turn the interpreter window on from the player, then move and resize it. Everyone else watches as usual. No re-editing, no re-uploading.

records.name: Arcjet AI security models
records.tagline: A family of custom-trained security models for coding agents
records.description: Arcjet is launching a family of custom AI security models designed for analyzing AI agent activity: Arcjet Himalia 1, a general purpose prompt injection model, live today for every SDK call that uses prompt injection detection, and specialist versions designed for situations that general models handle badly, Arcjet Thebe 1 for coding agents, and Arcjet Carme 1, for autonomous security agents.

records.name: Calmly Script
records.tagline: Beautiful screenwriting software. Pay once, no sign-up
records.description: Professional screenwriting software with a clean, beautiful interface: industry-standard pages, Final Draft files, an open format. No account, no tracking. Pay once. Windows, Mac, Linux, Android.

records.name: Databox CLI
records.tagline: Your agentic analytics platform in the terminal
records.description: Create data sources, load data, build metrics, and automate workflows directly from your terminal. Use 90+ commands yourself, or let AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex do the work with 10 ready-to-use agent skills.

records.name: Pawse.ai
records.tagline: Sound engineered for dogs, not humans
records.description: Pawse.ai writes sound for your dog while it plays. Every session is shaped to how dogs hear. Choose Sleep, Home Alone, Loud Noise, Travel or Vet Visit. Tell it what your dog did and the next session adjusts. The Apple TV app keeps playing after you leave.

records.name: ClipsPal
records.tagline: AI video editor that edits your talking-head videos
records.description: Desktop video editor for Mac and Windows. Drop in raw clips: ClipsPal cuts failed takes and silences, adds zoom-ins, subtitles, visuals and sound, then turns the video into shorts and articles. Runs on your Claude Code or Codex. Pay once, no subscription.

records.name: skuttr
records.tagline: Type one sentence, get a Reel from your camera roll
records.description: skuttr turns one sentence into a ready-to-post Reel. Type “Tokyo solo trip” and it finds the right photos and videos on your iPhone, puts the strongest shot first and has a vertical Reel ready in under a minute. Your first 5 Reels are free.

records.name: Voyager
records.tagline: ✴️ An agentic file browser to navigate your work context
records.description: Voyager brings AI agents into your everyday file work on macOS. Find the files you need and work with AI agents using them as context, all within a familiar file browser. Meet a file browser built for finding your files and putting them to work with AI.

records.name: KIKUmap
records.tagline: A mind map for your Claude and ChatGPT chats
records.description: A macOS menu-bar app and desktop widget: see which Claude and ChatGPT chats are running, done or waiting for you, and arrange them as a mind map. Free and open source.

records.name: Nörth
records.tagline: Natural, peer-to-peer collaboration for remote work
records.description: Nörth brings remote teams together with spatial voice chat, drop-in rooms, and voice and video messaging. Peer-to-peer, end-to-end encrypted, and native to macOS.

records.name: Cue
records.tagline: AI meeting notes, prep
records.description: An AI crew for macOS that helps you in meetings: they prepare you before a call, take the notes and guide you during it, and draft the follow-ups after. Between meetings, they type what you say in any app and answer about what is on your screen.

records.name: Product Hunt MCP
records.tagline: The community you trust in the assistant you use
records.description: Ask your AI assistant to find your next favorite product. Explore new launches, compare alternatives, and see what the Product Hunt community thinks. Building something yourself? Turn your README and website into a launch draft, add images, and check what's missing before you submit. Sign in with Product Hunt to connect. No API key needed.

records.name: Paycheck Lab
records.tagline: Free US paycheck, mortgage and loan calculators
records.description: Free calculators for common US money questions: take-home pay for all 50 states + DC (2026 rules), mortgage, auto and personal loans, home affordability, credit card payoff and compound interest. No sign-up. Estimates only. Ad-supported.

records.name: ClipsPal
records.tagline: AI video editor that edits your talking-head videos
records.description: Desktop video editor for Mac and Windows. Drop in raw clips: ClipsPal cuts failed takes and silences, adds zoom-ins, subtitles, visuals and sound, then turns the video into shorts and articles. Runs on your Claude Code or Codex. Pay once, no subscription.

records.name: Slipmark
records.tagline: Make AI agents prove what they checked before anything ships
records.description: Make AI agents prove what they checked. Bind every agent verdict to a SHA-256 of the files it read, and refuse to ship on mismatch.

records.name: skuttr
records.tagline: Type one sentence, get a Reel from your camera roll
records.description: skuttr turns one sentence into a ready-to-post Reel. Type “Tokyo solo trip” and it finds the right photos and videos on your iPhone, puts the strongest shot first and has a vertical Reel ready in under a minute. Your first 5 Reels are free.

records.name: weedit Back To Top
records.tagline: Adds a subtle, customizable scroll-up arrow to long pages
records.description: The Back to Top button is a vital accessibility and navigation tool for modern, content-heavy websites. It automatically appears after a set scroll distance, offering a quick, single-click return to the top of the page. This enhanced version includes a customizable scroll progress indicator around the button, giving users a visual cue of their current position. You can fully customize the design, size, position, visibility threshold, scroll duration and more.

records.name: Japan Product Radar
records.tagline: 10 products trending in Japan, each checked vs US saturation
records.description: A monthly English report curated in Tokyo from Makuake crowdfunding and ranking data. Each issue features 10 products trending in Japan, each checked against US saturation, with sourcing keywords and risk flags. Issue #1 is out now at $29 launch pricing, with a 7-day money-back guarantee.

records.name: Agent studio
records.tagline: Team up agents to work on task with shared content
records.description: Agent Studio lets you create your own team of AI colleagues and have them work together on a single task with shared context. Instead of one generic chat, you assemble specialists who research, write, review and structure work in sequence. Each colleague builds on the previous step, and the final result is shown first. Early version. Bring your own API key. Feedback welcome.

records.name: HeadVox
records.tagline: Script → voiceover + word-aligned captions, open source
records.description: Turn a text or Markdown script into a natural TTS voiceover plus SRT/WebVTT captions timed to the spoken words and a per-word JSON timeline. Optional one-step video mux with ffmpeg. Chinese, English, Japanese. Free, MIT, pip install.

records.name: The Book Recommendation Box
records.tagline: Pick a recommendation, leave one behind!
records.description: Think of it as a little free library, but for book recommendations: a simple, welcoming space where readers can share their favourite reads and discover new ones. The goal is to bring back the joy of pure discovery: stepping outside my usual reading habits, exploring new genres, and discovering authors and stories you might never have come across otherwise. Because sometimes, the best book recommendations come from people, not algorithms.

records.name: Scale Nutrition
records.tagline: AI-powered food analysis and daily calorie tracking
records.description: Scale Nutrition is an AI-powered food calorie and nutrition tracking app by Scale Us Technologies LLP. Analyze meals using food photos, get estimated calories and nutritional values, set daily calorie goals, track your food intake, and review your meal history. Configure your own Google Gemini API key to power AI-based food analysis.

records.name: Block Breaker
records.tagline: Classic block breaker, reborn for the browser
records.description: 🧱 Block Breaker – The Ultimate Brick Puzzle Game! 🧠 Get ready to drop, stack, and clear your way to victory in Block Breaker, the most addictive and relaxing block puzzle game! Whether you're a casual gamer or a puzzle master, this retro-inspired game will keep you playing for hours. 🎮 How to Play Drop falling blocks into the grid Align shapes to complete full horizontal lines Clear lines to score points and avoid grid overflow The more lines you clear at once, the score will be increase!

records.name: Safe Speed
records.tagline: Safety-scored driving leagues for car clubs
records.description: Safe Speed gives car clubs recurring weekly and monthly driving leagues, route partners measurable visits, and mobility platforms a future ride-comfort score.

records.name: Bounce Clash: Slingshot RPG
records.tagline: Sling heroes, bounce off walls, combo with your team
records.description: A vintage cartoon roguelite for iOS & Android. Pull back and launch your heroes, ricochet off walls, and collide with allies to trigger team combos. Pick new upgrades every run, beat bosses, and unlock heroes and gear between battles.

records.name: Nova
records.tagline: an macOS Notch App
records.description: Nova turns your MacBook's notch into a sleek, pure-black Dynamic Island. Hover to expand it, move away and it disappears. 🎵 Music controls, album art & live lyrics 🤖 AI assistant: Apple Intelligence, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude or Groq 📅 Calendar with one-click meeting join 🌤 Weather at a glance ⏱ Pomodoro focus sessions 🗂 File shelf for drag & drop 📋 Clipboard history 🔔 Volume, brightness, AirPods & battery alerts Works on Macs without a notch too. Native Swift, 6 languages.

records.name: TidyDrive
records.tagline: Safely scan, rename and tidy drives and ZIPs on Windows.
records.description: TidyDrive scans drives, folders and ZIPs into one list, suggests clearer file names, and holds every change until you Confirm. Windows 10/11, $10 one-time.

records.name: Wander Pixels
records.tagline: Link-in-bio page for real-time camera photos and finds
records.description: Wander Pixels is a link-in-bio profile and shared camera roll with zero AI slop. Every photo is captured in real time directly from your camera—documenting real cafes, trails, food, and books. Build your personal page to showcase your links, share authentic local finds, flip through interactive reading diaries, and climb the community leaderboard.

records.name: BK Tools
records.tagline: Offline Android tools for PDFs, JSON and everyday tasks
records.description: BK Tools puts PDF tools, a JSON formatter, unit converters, calculators, and text and planning utilities in one Android app. The tools run offline and process inputs on your device. Free, with no ads or account required. Available in English and Turkish, with light and dark modes.

records.name: AgencyOS- Agency in One Notion Workspace
records.tagline: notion
records.description: Welcome to WaslaCX AgencyOS, a connected Notion template for marketing and creative agencies.

records.name: Safe Image Save
records.tagline: Convert and save web images with 100% local privacy.
records.description: Tired of modern formats like WebP or uploading sensitive graphics to third-party conversion sites? Safe Image Save lets you right-click any image on the web and instantly save it in your preferred format (PNG, JPG, WebP, or AVIF). Built with client-side conversion technology, it works entirely offline in your browser to guarantee maximum privacy and zero latency.

records.name: Muse AI Assistant Blueprint
records.tagline: Automate email scheduling & inbox replies with autonomous AI
records.description: Stop burning hours on manual back-and-forth email scheduling. Muse AI Assistant Blueprint is a complete masterclass and setup kit to turn Gmail & Google Calendar into an autonomous AI agent. Unlike rigid Zapier rules, it understands context, checks real-time availability, and handles scheduling end-to-end. What’s Inside: • Step-by-step setup guide for Muse, Gmail & Calendar • Copy-paste system prompts & tone-matching frameworks • Smart buffer & double-booking protection rules

records.name: ToolsBox
records.tagline: Free Pdf & image tools
records.description: ToolsBox offers free online PDF and image tools. Merge, split and compress PDFs, convert images, resize pictures and reduce file sizes.

records.name: Marketing Operator
records.tagline: AI social media post drafts for small businesses & startups
records.description: AI-assisted social media post drafts for small businesses & startups. Owners review and approve every post.

records.name: Clac! Daily Origami
records.tagline: Fold your iPhone Duo. Fold an origami.
records.description: Every day Clac! gives you a sheet of paper with an origami hidden in it. Fold your iPhone Duo and the paper takes a fold, right on the cover screen, with a little paper "clac". On the last fold you see what it was: a crane, a fox, a lotus, a phoenix. No Duo? Every 500 steps counts as a fold. 30 origami, rare papers like gold-leaf washi, step-by-step instructions to fold them for real. Free to start, one purchase unlocks everything. No account, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: Brain Rush: Daily Mind Games
records.tagline: Made for You
records.description: Sharpen your memory, focus, speed and logic in just 3 to 5 minutes a day. Brain Rush turns brain training into a quick, fun daily habit. Each day you get a short session of mind games picked for you, complete with clear instructions, a countdown and results after every game.

records.name: Ghani: Wallet & Cash Book
records.tagline: Offline ledger for debts and multi-currency wallets
records.description: Know who owes you, whom you owe, and what you hold in each currency. Ghani gives every person, shop or account its own wallet. Works offline, no ads, in Arabic, English, French and Urdu. Pro adds unlimited wallets, PDF/Excel reports and biometric lock.

records.name: Pressie
records.tagline: Remember birthdays and gift ideas, no ads or subscriptions
records.description: Pressie keeps birthdays, gift ideas and gift budgets in one place on your iPhone. Reminders before each birthday, a spend tracker per person, and Christmas lists. £2.99 once. No adverts, no subscriptions, no account, and your data stays on your phone.

records.name: Bitzy
records.tagline: Learn to code. Understand what you build.
records.description: 🚀 Welcome to Bitzy – Level Up Your Coding Skills! Bitzy is an interactive coding learning platform designed to help beginners and aspiring developers learn programming through practical lessons, quizzes, coding challenges, and real-world projects. Whether you're starting your programming journey or improving your existing skills, Bitzy provides everything you need to become a confident developer.

records.name: Scale Compress Tools
records.tagline: Compress PDFs, images and videos directly on your device.
records.description: Scale Compress Tools is an Android file compression app that helps you reduce the size of PDFs, images, videos and documents directly on your device. Manage compressed files, save storage space and share files easily without uploading them to an online service.

records.name: Trinkets: Trip Collages
records.tagline: Save the little moments
records.description: Life moves fast. Trinkets helps you slow down and collect the little moments. Make a trip, add your photos, and Trinkets does the rest. It cuts out the people, pets and little things in each photo, right on your iPhone, and arranges them into one collage for the whole trip. No fiddly editing, no templates.

records.name: FlightGlobe – Flight Tracker
records.tagline: Flight Tracker & Travel Companion
records.description: FlightGlobe turns every flight into a story you can see, share, and grow. Make every flight count forever. Track your routes, claim your countries, explore visa maps & rankings, and build a passport that turns ordinary travel into your personal legend. From runway to memory in one beautiful app. FlightGlobe maps your flights on a living globe and builds a passport so powerful you'll need to share it.

records.name: Bop
records.tagline: Bop — One hub, separate browser sessions per account
records.description: Bop is a personal hub that lets you keep several messaging accounts apart on one device. One hub window gives each account its own browser session — Messenger in A, Facebook in B, a paid-study board watching itself in C. Each space has its own cookies, storage, and cache, so the accounts never see each other. The hub hides into the tray when you close it, keeps listening, and a small floating bubble tells you which account moved.

records.name: Pacely: Smart Habit Tracker
records.tagline: Stop chasing badges. Start building habits.
records.description: Habits aren't built on badges. They're built week by week, by people who show up and want to know it's working. If that's you, Pacely is for you. Set your targets, log your days, see how far you've come. You build the habit. Leave the math to us.

records.name: Moisturising Lotion
records.tagline: Scan products. Understand them in your language.
records.description: Ingredients, nutrition and product information for Moisturising Lotion — CeraVe on Hêja. Multiple peer-reviewed studies and ECHA confirm that Phenoxyethanol and Ethylhexylglycerin cause irreversible eye damage (H318). CosIng Annex V lis…

records.name: Alpha — Local Chess Analysis for Android
records.tagline: Alpha is an offline-first Android chess analysis app
records.description: A local-first Android chess-analysis app for studying positions, reviewing full games, importing PGNs, and finding patterns in your play.

records.name: Miamzo
records.tagline: Plan dinner from what's already in your fridge.
records.description: Miamzo plans dinner from food already in your fridge, using expiring items first. It builds one grocery list for the household, with only what you don't have. Snap a shelf, get a week of meals, cook step by step.

records.name: Sprout: Side Hustle Planner
records.tagline: Plan & grow your side hustle
records.description: Starting something of your own shouldn't feel overwhelming. Sprout helps you find a small business that fits your life — and then shows you exactly what to do today. FIND AN IDEA THAT FITS YOU Answer a few quick questions about your interests, budget and time. Sprout suggests ideas that match: from mushroom growing and candle making to freelance design, tutoring or a mobile coffee cart.

records.name: One More Step: Health Tracker
records.tagline: count your steps, calories, growth, habits, water intake.
records.description: One More Step is your all-in-one companion for building healthier daily habits — steps, hydration, nutrition, and routines, all tracked in one clean, distraction-free app. Whether you're trying to hit 10,000 steps, stay hydrated, log your meals, or simply remember to drink water on time, One More Step keeps everything in sync — so you always know exactly where you stand.

records.name: Duotronic
records.tagline: TNG-themed retro calendar & reminders
records.description: Duotronic puts your calendar and reminders on a retro-futuristic console of rounded color bars and panels. It works with the Calendar and Reminders already on your device, so everything stays in sync with Apple's apps and your accounts. Every button is a chunky segment with a satisfying synthesized sound. YOUR CALENDAR • DAY: an hour-by-hour timeline, with overlapping events side by side and a line marking now. • WEEK: seven days at a glance.

records.name: DAYFLOW
records.tagline: Plan your day, build better habits, and manage your money.
records.description: DAYFLOW is your personal productivity dashboard designed to help you stay organized and make every day count. With DAYFLOW, you can: Manage your daily tasks and priorities. Track your daily habits and build consistency. Monitor your monthly spending with Money Manager. View your daily progress from one simple dashboard. Stay focused with a clean, modern interface. Whether you're studying, working, or managing your daily life, DAYFLOW helps you stay productive and organized.

records.name: MediaPlayerAI
records.tagline: Smart,  privacy-first Windows media player with AI features
records.description: MediaPlayerAI v2.0.0 is a smart, privacy-first desktop media player featuring a redesigned sidebar UI, multiple dynamic themes (AMOLED, Dracula, Nord, custom HEX), advanced playback controls, resume feature, and live subtitle customization. Completely FREE for Windows!

records.name: Clipmonger
records.tagline: A highly configurable cross-platform clipboard manager.
records.description: Clipmonger is a cross-platform clipboard history manager written in Rust. It remembers everything you copy (text, images and file lists), opens a popup on a global hotkey and pastes the clip you pick straight into the window you came from. It runs on Windows 10/11, on macOS 10.15 and newer (Intel and Apple Silicon), and on Linux under X11 and Wayland, including GNOME Wayland through a bundled GNOME Shell extension.

records.name: Anglebound
records.tagline: A ricochet-angle puzzle for iPhone
records.description: Aim, lock your shot, then fine-tune it in half-degree steps. Guide a bouncing ball through 120 levels across 8 worlds, a shared daily level, and a 1,000-level endless run. The first world and daily level are free; one in-app purchase unlocks the full game. Offline play, with no ads or subscription.

records.name: bodysizecele
records.tagline: Celebrity Height   Practical body-size calculatorsrity tools
records.description: Bodysizecele combines celebrity profiles, publicly available biographical information, body measurement references, and practical online calculators. Explore celebrity heights, fitness and fashion information, and use free BMI, age, and bra size calculators through a simple, user-friendly website.

records.name: Broodli
records.tagline: Your family's mental load, handled — in Telegram.
records.description: Broodli is a family planner inside Telegram. Text or dictate your routine—school runs, quiet hours, no-go times—and get plans that fit. Tap Make today lighter for an essentials-first day. Share editable to-do and shopping lists, assign tasks to family, and repeat weekly chores. Reminders respect allergies; groceries are only those you name. No app, setup or calendar sync. Free to start; Pro from $4.99.

records.name: MiutChat
records.tagline: Free Anonymous Encrypted Chat
records.description: MiutChat is a privacy-focused, anonymous messaging platform that lets you communicate without accounts, registrations, or phone numbers. Create or join private chat rooms using unique room codes. With AES-256-GCM encryption, disappearing messages, group chats, file sharing, and room management features, MiutChat puts privacy and control first. Enjoy simple, secure, and convenient communication without sharing your identity. No accounts, no unnecessary data, just private conversations.

records.name: nexora
records.tagline: Connect, Chat, Share and Meet in One Place.
records.description: Nexora — connect and communicate. Nexora is a social communication platform that brings people together through private messaging, group conversations, video meetings, friendships and Pulse, where users can share temporary photos and videos.

records.name: Busted! Imposter Party Game
records.tagline: Bluff your way through clues. Don't get Busted!
records.description: A free party game for 3-10 players. Everyone knows the secret word except the Imposter, who has to bluff through the clues. Then you discuss and vote. Play on one phone or online in a room, no sign-up.

records.name: NimbleOrder Change Requests
records.tagline: Reviewed address and phone requests for WooCommerce orders
records.description: Give customers a signed, time-limited link to request a shipping address or phone correction after payment. Review each request in WooCommerce before applying it. The queue records proposed changes and warns when shipping or tracking data may already exist. It does not change products, prices, payments, labels, or carrier records.

records.name: StoreOpti
records.tagline: Instant local WebP image compressor & SEO renamer
records.description: A lightning-fast, 100% private web tool for store owners. Compress images, convert to WebP, auto-resize for Shopify/WooCommerce, and optimize file names for SEO—all directly in your browser. No server uploads, no sign-ups, completely free.

records.name: Research Logbook
records.tagline: A free Windows notebook for notes, pictures and next steps
records.description: Research Logbook is a free Windows beta for keeping project notes, pictures, sources and tasks together. Change the sections to suit a dissertation, literature review or course project. Notes stay as readable Markdown and local pictures in a folder you choose, with no separate app account or cloud sync. Three free starter kits include blank layouts and clearly fictional worked examples.

records.name: Lumo Dynamic Pricing
records.tagline: WooCommerce quantity tiers, BOGO offers and gifts
records.description: Create scoped WooCommerce promotions using quantity tiers, BOGO offers, gifts, role-based pricing and scheduled discount rules. Select eligible products and customer conditions, then test the complete cart and checkout before starting a promotion.

records.name: Effera - Motion Video Editor
records.tagline: Watermark-free video editor: drag while playing to animate
records.description: Effera is a phone video editor with no watermark and no export paywalls, built around direct touch motion. Play your timeline, touch the preview, and drag a caption, stamp, mosaic, or effect with your finger—the path you trace is recorded as smooth motion. When paused, dragging adjusts only the current frame. You can animate text, stickers, and tracking blur naturally without manually placing keyframes one by one.

records.name: Gym Class Pass Manager
records.tagline: Transform WordPress into the all-in-one app for gyms
records.description: Gym Class Pass Manager transform your WordPress website into an all-in-one app for managing your fitness box, gym, or sports center: class bookings with capacity limits and membership-based restrictions, integrated payments via the most reliable payment gateways, a social network for your members, and a module for uploading and completing workouts—complete with a library of over 300 exercises. Gym Class is everything you need!

records.name: Bonkforge: Idle Coin Clicker
records.tagline: Tap the machine, bolt on parts, and press your coin empire.
records.description: Bonkforge is a cozy idle clicker about the friendliest machine in the coin business. Tap it to stamp money, then bolt on parts and grow it into a roaring money factory. Every upgrade appears right on the machine and visibly evolves as it levels. Its eyes follow your finger. It dozes when you're away. Long-press to pet it. Dress it up in hats it earns. Trophies, daily goals and a daily crate keep every session rewarding. Free to play, built to be tapped. Start bonking!

records.name: adbtd
records.tagline: Have a domain? Spin your email infrastructure in 60 seconds.
records.description: Get a pristine dedicated mail infrastructure under your domain in minutes - plug our MCP and start sending emails now. We don't use cloud IPs. Every customer is a fully isolated tenant: you get your instance of postfix, sendmail, roundcube, and the PTR is showing your dedicated IP. You own your reputation, and we give you the tools to keep it high. Stop outgoing emails before they harm you, monitor your reputation on Microsoft and Google, evaluate the quality of your copywriting.

records.name: Seller Image Brief Free
records.tagline: Turn product facts into up to three image briefs
records.description: Turn product facts and supplied buyer comments into up to three text image briefs, with FABE, shot plans and evidence gaps. This Agent Skill plans images; it does not generate them. The workflow and examples are in Chinese; English use needs translation or adaptation and is untested. Bring a compatible Agent, your own model access and any model fees. The vehicle demo is synthetic, from a historical maker self-test. Custom license; no time-saving or sales guarantees.

records.name: T-break: Quit Vaping Tracker
records.tagline: Your personal tracker for quitting vaping.
records.description: T-break is a quit vaping app and puff counter that helps you cut down and quit vaping or smoking, one puff at a time. Tap Puff every time you use. That's it. T-break turns those taps into a clear picture of your habit, so you can see it change. Free with ads. T-break Pro is a one-time purchase that removes all ads and unlocks full history charts and craving-pattern insights. No subscription. T-break is a self-help tool, not a medical device, and doesn't replace professional care.

records.name: Hearthscale
records.tagline: Run local code, music, image, video & transcription models
records.description: Discover, download and build apps with on-device code, voice, image, video, music and transcription models. Launches today with meeting notes, system-wide dictation, image and music generation, and an agent. Hearthscale is 100% free, private, and needs no account! Deploy Hearthscale Server in one click or with Docker on your most capable device. It connects to the client automatically and serves local AI models, end-to-end encrypted, to your other devices running Hearthscale.

records.name: Myeline
records.tagline: One memory for every AI you use.
records.description: Myeline is a memory layer for AI assistants that connects to Claude, ChatGPT, and any client using the MCP protocol. It stores facts it learns about you, each with a source, ensuring transparent responses. If it finds no matching information you approved, Myeline says so instead of guessing. The name comes from myelin, the sheath that insulates nerve fibers for quick, accurate signal transmission. Myeline functions as an intermediary between your AI and its memory, requiring your approval.

records.name: Andy Home Care
records.tagline: Home maintenance, remembered
records.description: Andy helps you remember the small jobs that keep a home running—without turning care into another source of pressure. Start with a few details about your home. Andy builds an editable snapshot, suggests seasonal care, and keeps routine tasks, appliances, and completed work together. With Andy, you can: Andy is local-first and works without an account. Your home details, care schedule, contacts, notes, photos, and history stay on your device. Optional online lookups are clearly identified.

records.name: Noxium: Private Photo Vault
records.tagline: Hidden is not private. Draw a line to open your vault
records.description: An iPhone and iPad app that hides photos, videos and notes in encrypted vaults. Draw a pattern across at least 6 bolts on a 5×5 plate of 25 bolts. Face ID can open the main vault. Everything is encrypted on the device. Keys come from your pattern through Argon2id (libsodium); files are sealed with AES-256-GCM (Apple CryptoKit). Names, dates and places are encrypted too. The pattern is never stored. An encrypted backup goes to your own private iCloud (CloudKit).

records.name: Umar speak analytics
records.tagline: Web developer seo
records.description: This is only the beginning. If something doesn't work, or you want a feature, please tell me: umarm562@gmail.com. Your feedback will shape what I build next.

records.name: TimeDrip
records.tagline: Revive the forgotten moments hidden in your iOS Live Photos
records.description: Turn your Live Photos into high frame-rate slow-motion videos and GIF loops worth sharing. A smile, a splash, a jump, a moment you wish lasted longer is now possible. TimeDrip helps you bring it all back to life. Save Live Photos as videos and GIFs loops to your Photos app gallery, and share them through your favorite apps. All photos are processed on your device and no internet connection or an account is required.

records.name: Project Unwind
records.tagline: A little Diwali light, a little time to unwind 🪔
records.description: Celebrating Diwali with Team Unwind! A festive reminder to spread positivity, embrace new beginnings, and make time for mental well-being. Wishing everyone a bright and happy Diwali! 🪔💚

records.name: MediaPlace
records.tagline: One library for your photos, videos and design files
records.description: MediaPlace keeps every photo, video and design file in one library and finds any of them when you describe it. Share folders as pages with your logo and colors, collect files from clients with one link, publish a brand page with your logos, colors and fonts, and turn photos into videos. Free to start with 15 GB.

records.name: Mon petit dressing
records.tagline: Track, organize and plan baby clothing wardrobes by size
records.description: ​Mon Petit Dressing is an app designed to simplify life for expectant and young parents. It lets you build and manage a digital inventory of your baby's wardrobe by sizing tiers (e.g., birth, 3M, 6M, 1M+) and seasonal needs. ​Key Features: ​Smart Size & Season Tracking: Instantly see what clothes you have, what fits right now, and what needs to be anticipated for upcoming seasons. ​Inventory Control: Avoid buying duplicates and easily organize hand-me-downs or gifts from family and friends.

records.name: Taupe
records.tagline: Listen. Read along. Keep the thought.
records.description: Keep more from every listen. Taupe brings on-device podcast transcription, word-by-word read-along, translation into supported languages, and passage-linked notes to a library on your devices. Keep your thoughts with their sources, search saved transcripts, and choose your own synced folder. Core listening, transcripts, and notes are free. Optional paid Taupe Tunnel connects approved chat apps to your library—not a hosted AI model.

records.name: SVGDraw
records.tagline: Create, edit, optimize and export SVGs for the web
records.description: SVGDraw gives developers and designers 26 free SVG tools in one place. Edit vector nodes, trace PNG and JPEG images, recolor artwork, optimize with SVGO, animate SVGs, and export React/TSX or Vue components. Use the tools without signing up. Browser-side tools process artwork locally; raster tracing uses a server that returns the result and discards the upload.

records.name: MasteringKit
records.tagline: Online AI mastering: free to try, no signup, no card
records.description: MasteringKit is online AI mastering for musicians, producers and Suno song creators. Free to try: no signup, no credit card. Upload a WAV, MP3, FLAC or AIFF mix and hear your song mastered in about a minute, at a loudness that holds up on Spotify, Apple Music and YouTube. Shape it with 11 controls, 6 engineer styles, a 6-band EQ, or a sentence like "warmer, less harsh highs". Every change is a new version to A/B. Export 24-bit WAV or 320 kbps MP3. Free LUFS meter too.

records.name: Opaline for Mac
records.tagline: Capture, annotate, record and copy text on your Mac
records.description: Opaline is a menu bar app for screenshots and screen recording on Mac. Capture an area, a window or a whole scrolling page, mark it up with arrows and blur, record to MP4 or GIF, and copy text from anything on screen. Everything stays on your Mac.

records.name: gitring
records.tagline: Source control for coding agents
records.description: Before a coding agent writes, it says what it will change. gitring compares every plan, settles the ones that conflict, and asks you only about the rest. Works with Claude Code, Codex and any MCP agent, and mirrors main to GitHub. Team free for 14 days, no card.

records.name: Chronos Gateway
records.tagline: The firewall between AI agents and your production data
records.description: AI agents have already wiped production databases. Chronos Gateway is how you let yours write to real customer data anyway. Every agent gets a run token, never your Postgres password, and a private copy of one customer's rows. Safe changes merge back in one transaction, every row checked against live data. Deletes and big changes stop and wait for a human, who approves in plain English. Your row-level security still decides what it can write. Self-hosted. Free. Postgres 12-18, Supabase, Neon.

records.name: ponel
records.tagline: AI-designed link in bio with fan community & memberships
records.description: ponel is a free link-in-bio page that grows with you. Put your socials, shop and every link on ponel.app/yourname, then pick a genre and a vibe and let AI design your look and bio. Cut stickers from your own photos to decorate it. When you're ready, post updates for fans, offer monthly memberships with members-only posts, and sell digital downloads or bookable sessions. Free for creators and fans, no ads. Paid features are open to Japan-based creators for now.

records.name: Cogent AI: Impulse Interceptor
records.tagline: A brake pedal for your impulsive decisions
records.description: Cogent catches impulsive decisions before you act. Dump the thought by text or voice, and AI identifies the bias driving it (FOMO, sunk cost, novelty, etc.). Face sharp, goal-based questions from an AI devil's advocate, then lock the decision in a smart cooling-off period, from an hour to two weeks. 30 days later, review whether it was worth it and track your Rationality Score. Topics: Productivity, Health & Fitness, Personal Finance, Artificial Intelligence

records.name: Lingoken
records.tagline: The activity maker for language teachers
records.description: Language teachers spend hours every week creating activities that students will want to work through. Lingoken helps them create these in the form of short fun games making learning a language feel like play. Using AI to generate the material, the activities can be customised to the students' level, target exam, or immigration requirements. Teachers can focus on their lesson plan and leave the practice to Lingoken. These activities can also be played during class for some fun group engagement.

records.name: LoyerPro
records.tagline: Simple rent management for landlords in Africa
records.description: LoyerPro helps landlords in Togo, Ghana and Benin manage rents without notebooks. See who paid, who didn't pay, and when rent is due - all on your phone. Built for owners with 2 to 50 tenants. No Excel, no stress. Track payments, tenants, and houses in one place.

records.name: Hackerz Online III
records.tagline: We are BACK after 5 years! Single-world Multiplayer RPG
records.description: Hackerz Online 3 is a free-to-play multiplayer hacking simulator wrapped in a retro neon terminal interface. You boot up with a beat-up gateway and a single mining rig, and one goal: claw your way up the global leaderboards by out-scanning, out-hacking and outlasting every other hacker on the network. There is no single-player here. Every rig you build, every firewall you breach and every point of reputation you earn lives in a shared, always-online world where real players are trying to do...

records.name: Tea Brewing Timer
records.tagline: Water, leaf, and time for 6 teas — no app, no sign-up.
records.description: I kept ruining good tea with wrong water temperature and steeping time, so I built a free timer that does the remembering for me. Pick your tea (green, white, yellow, oolong, black, pu-erh) and mug or gongfu brewing, and it shows the water temperature, how much leaf to use, and counts down each steep — with a beep when it's ready. Mild / medium / strong, ±30s adjust, keeps running if you switch tabs. English and Chinese in one click. Free, no account.

records.name: MelonAds
records.tagline: Your Marketing agency in your pocket
records.description: Instead of "just create and manage ads" strat from your identity, who are you, what do you solve, afterwords, your in your self playgrown of creativity. preapare, create and lunch campaigns with melonads ai assistant

records.name: Voyager
records.tagline: ✴️ An agentic file browser to navigate your work context
records.description: Voyager brings AI agents into your everyday file work on macOS. Find the files you need and work with AI agents using them as context, all within a familiar file browser. Meet a file browser built for finding your files and putting them to work with AI.

records.name: Keltra
records.tagline: Auto-complete for your Web Assets
records.description: Keltra scans your asset folders and generates a typed manifest, so every image and file path in your code gets autocomplete and type-checking.

records.name: KIKUmap
records.tagline: A mind map for your Claude and ChatGPT chats
records.description: A macOS menu-bar app and desktop widget: see which Claude and ChatGPT chats are running, done or waiting for you, and arrange them as a mind map. Free and open source.

records.name: Chord
records.tagline: A CRM for creatives that protects your boundaries
records.description: Chord gives your clients one branded portal for proposals, contracts, invoices, files and feedback. It also protects your boundaries by preventing scope creep, and helps you beat the feast-or-famine cycle with forecasts for your workload and income.

records.name: Maapzy
records.tagline: Discover Places. Plan Adventures. Share Memories.
records.description: Plan journeys with friends, discover and save places, track your travels, and share the memories with Maapzy. Create your free journey.

records.name: Nörth
records.tagline: Natural, peer-to-peer collaboration for remote work
records.description: Nörth brings remote teams together with spatial voice chat, drop-in rooms, and voice and video messaging. Peer-to-peer, end-to-end encrypted, and native to macOS.

records.name: Cinejoy
records.tagline: Watch Moives and Tv Series online
records.description: Discover trending movies, new releases, and TV series. Explore cast, genres, ratings, and title details on Cinejoy.

records.name: Paper Animator
records.tagline: paperanimator.org
records.description: Turn a photo or typed text into a stop-motion paper animation with Paper Animator. Make torn-edge stickers, export MP4 or transparent PNG, all in your browser.

records.name: GainBoard
records.tagline: Next-gen trading journal for Perp DEX & multi-asset traders
records.description: GainBoard is an automated trading journal and portfolio tracker built for perp DEXes, onchain wallets, and top exchanges. Features non-custodial sync, multi-leg WAP tracking, AI trade analytics, and tax-ready audit reports.

records.name: Cue
records.tagline: AI meeting notes, prep
records.description: An AI crew for macOS that helps you in meetings: they prepare you before a call, take the notes and guide you during it, and draft the follow-ups after. Between meetings, they type what you say in any app and answer about what is on your screen.

records.name: Herald.ink
records.tagline: Free D&D campaign manager that also runs your table
records.description: Herald.ink is a free campaign manager for Dungeon Masters: NPCs, maps, factions and lore that remember each other, live-play tools for the table, handouts for your players, and a quick quill when you're stuck.

records.name: Tarca
records.tagline: A space for all your work
records.description: Tarca keeps projects, customers, documents, and next steps connected—from the first idea or inquiry through delivery. Plan tasks, manage CRM and sales, create and sign documents, build forms, review designs, publish web pages, and automate workflows. AI Meeting Notes provides transcripts, summaries, and action items you can turn into tasks. Use Tarca in your browser or download the Mac and Windows desktop application. Take a moment to explore the public demo at https://tarca.app/demo

records.name: Dreven
records.tagline: AI-assisted accessibility audits a person signs off
records.description: Give Dreven one address. It finds your site's pages, checks them against WCAG 2.2, gathers evidence for every result and marks what it cannot settle as can't tell. You decide each result, then it drafts a VPAT 2.5Rev conformance report for you to sign.

records.name: Novus ProjectOS
records.tagline: One plan for everyone on the work, whoever they work for
records.description: Project teams work across too many apps, so communication scatters. Novus puts your team, clients and partners on one project page, with roles, chats and a library for your files. Turn finished projects into templates to learn how long each one actually takes.

records.name: Reelspan
records.tagline: Post one video. Reframed & captioned for every platform.
records.description: Upload one video and Reelspan reframes it for every feed (9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9), writes a caption per platform and publishes or schedules it to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, X and more. Dashboard, REST API and MCP for AI agents.

records.name: x-trades.live
records.tagline: Crypto trade calls and forecasts, audited
records.description: A live audit of crypto traders and analysts on X and Telegram: every trade call tracked to its target, stop or exit, every price forecast checked on real prices.

records.name: StalkMail
records.tagline: Everything you need to run a newsletter
records.description: Campaigns, subscribers and scheduling in one clean dashboard, plus an API your AI agents can use. Every feature on every plan, from $15 a month.

records.name: ChalkTalk
records.tagline: Narrated tutorial videos you can edit scene by scene
records.description: Turn complex technical topics into narrated tutorial videos with editable scenes. ChalkTalk transforms your content into visual explanations using code, diagrams, charts, terminal sessions, and math. Edit any scene or sentence and preview the result without recording again. Create videos in the web editor or directly through MCP using Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or Cursor. Free during early access, with support for your own API keys from Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter and more.

records.name: MemeHatch
records.tagline: Turn one pet photo into a viral meme video
records.description: Upload one photo of your dog or cat and get a 10-second AI meme video: the Skull Cap trend with a free preview, or a pet dance. $4.99, pets only.

records.name: Scaife Viewer
records.tagline: Open-Source Reader Classical Texts & Parallel Translations
records.description: open-source reading environment for classical literature, built to power the Perseus Digital Library. Read Ancient Greek and Latin texts side-by-side with English translations, click any word for instant morphological parsing and dictionary lookup, and cite passages precisely using CTS URN deep links. With 85M+ words of pre-modern literature, no paywalls, and a clean modern UI (Vue.js, Django, GraphQL), it's built for self-learners, students, writers, and digital humanists.

records.name: CostGraph for CI
records.tagline: OpenRouter, but on CI. Your integration, a cheaper outcome
records.description: CostGraph AutoPilot for CI routes each job to the best runner you already have: GitHub-hosted, Blacksmith, Ubicloud, Jog, Avrea, or your own Kubernetes cluster. Pick cheapest, fastest or balanced. A runner it has never tried gets one run, and stays only if the real run comes in cheaper and no slower. Your free minutes count, and nothing breaks: if anything goes wrong, the job keeps its own runner. One step in your workflow: uses: baselinehq/costgraph-action/route@v0 Free with CostGraph.

records.name: EtiquetaChef
records.tagline: Food expiry labels for professional kitchens
records.description: Print and track expiration labels right from your phone.

records.name: RED
records.tagline: Conecta marcas con creadores
records.description: La plataforma para campañas con creadores de contenido.

records.name: Independent Kitesurf Roadmap
records.tagline: Your roadmap to becoming an independent kitesurfer
records.description: Plenty of times I felt like giving up, or wasn’t sure I was even doing the right things in the right order. This is the roadmap I wish I'd had: every step from first kitesurf lesson to riding solo. Prepare mentally before your classes, watch great video contents and make progress faster! Don't give up, it's 100% worth becoming indenpent! 🪁

records.name: HiMeet
records.tagline: Skill-based Web3 chess, social networking, and classifieds.
records.description: ChessBet is a multi-functional Web3 ecosystem on Polygon. Compete in skill-based chess for USDC stakes The game features unique animated, talking cartoon chess pieces that bring the board to life, and allows you to mint exclusive NFTs from your best in-game moves. Beyond gaming, ChessBet is a powerful social hub. Enjoy a global classifieds section and an 18+ social/dating network, both equipped with real-time online translation for seamless communication across chats and ads. Play responsibly.

records.name: EuroCrime
records.tagline: Crime news, personal push messages,13 languages, free,
records.description: European Crime news in your own languages. With personal push notifacations

records.name: AnyBucket
records.tagline: SFTP, FTP, S3, Azure, WebDAV and SMB in two panes on a Mac
records.description: AnyBucket puts your Mac and any server side by side: SFTP, FTP, FTPS, Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Azure Blob, WebDAV and SMB. Each pane shows This Mac or a server, so Mac to server and server to server are the same gesture: mark files, press F5. On the same server the copy runs there. ⌘K goes anywhere, Compare & Sync mirrors two folders, and the queue survives dropped connections and relaunches. Native Swift, 18 languages, no account. $9.99 once, for two Macs.

records.name: Fotoshi
records.tagline: Build fresh, useful map knowledge one photo at a time
records.description: Fotoshi is a contributor-built visual record of the physical world. People photograph places and objects where they are, creating map-linked evidence of what is there, what it looks like, and what has changed. Photos contributed to Fotoshi can be used to train and evaluate GeoAI and machine-learning models. We are developing ways to turn visual evidence into structured information that improves Fotoshi and supports community projects, open-source research and industry applications.

records.name: D97 Game
records.tagline: Mobile entertainment with in-game coins and rewards
records.description: D97 Game is a mobile entertainment app that brings casual games, in-game coins, spins, and daily rewards together in one place. Players can enjoy a variety of simple games, collect in-game rewards, and take part in daily and referral benefits that make each visit fun. The app is designed for relaxed, everyday entertainment, with clear rewards and an easy way to keep track of coins and spins earned inside the app.

records.name: AgentPark
records.tagline: Multiplayer AI workspace with one company brain
records.description: Bringing people and AI agents together to collaborate, share knowledge, and create in one connected workspace. http://agentpark.si

records.name: Seleto
records.tagline: An AI employee that answers your WhatsApp customers 24/7

records.description: Codeen is a fast, mobile-friendly agentic development environment (ADE). Run multiple AI coding agents in parallel across different branches, each in its own isolated worktree. Built for modern development workflows, Codeen includes free network traffic proxy tool, built-in logging, automatic environment detection, device emulators, and real-time device mirroring.

records.name: Pawfect
records.tagline: AI content studio for pet brands — generate listing visuals
records.description: Pawfect is an AI content studio built for Shopify & Amazon pet brands. Replace expensive freelance photoshoots: turn ordinary product photos into brand‑aligned lifestyle imagery, listing copy, and social creatives in ~60 seconds. Built‑in Amazon & FTC compliance checks, Brand Kit style‑lock, and commercial‑use license included. Upload your photo, pick templates, generate ready‑to‑publish assets without prompt engineering.

records.name: Wizstar viral-video-recreation
records.tagline: Turn Viral Videos into Your Product Ads
records.description: Wizstar’s Viral Video Recreation helps creators and marketers turn proven viral formats into engaging product videos. Simply upload a product and choose a high-performing video as a reference. Wizstar AI analyzes its structure, shots, pacing, and background music, then recreates the format with your product in one click. No need to start from scratch or experiment with different creative approaches. Create videos in minutes and scale production with proven formats.

records.name: 70 Inch Fireplace TV Stand LED Lights
records.tagline: A fireplace tv stand with led lights 36" electric fireplace
records.description: 70 inch fireplace TV stand with LED lights: 36 inch insert, 12 flame colors, dual LED glow, fits 80 inch TVs, black.

records.name: Teddy Tally
records.tagline: Monthly bill tracking for Android
records.description: Teddy Tally helps you organize monthly bills, record payments, and see how much remains from a selected paycheck. A monthly progress ribbon shows paid bills and the amount left to pay. Available for Android on Google Play.

records.name: ClearCaptions
records.tagline: Automatic Spanish & English captions for your videos
records.description: Upload an MP4 in Spanish or English and get editable captions, SRT and VTT files, a transcript and a captioned video. Try up to 60 seconds free, with limited daily slots, or pay per video. Captions follow the original audio language; translation is not included.

records.name: $1,000 Amazon Gift Card Giveaway
records.tagline: Get a Chance to Win a $1,000 Amazon Gift Card!
records.description: Exciting news for online shopping lovers in the USA! We're promoting an exclusive opportunity to win a $1,000 Amazon Gift Card. Explore the offer, check your eligibility, and follow the official entry instructions for a chance to receive this amazing reward.

records.name: RapTake
records.tagline: Create solo or duet AI rap videos from your photos
records.description: Turn your photos into a solo or duet AI rap video. Choose a prepared rap track, scene and format, review the character preview, then generate and download the finished performance. Browse complete creation examples before starting. Paid video packs are available.

records.name: Vendifys
records.tagline: Turn your store into a virtual vending machine
records.description: VENDIFYS is an enterprise storefront platform that transforms your brand into a custom interactive vending machine experience. We sit between e-commerce and retail media. You get a high-engagement digital storefront hosted on vendifys.com

records.name: Nervous System Calmer: Breathe
records.tagline: Calm in one minute – breathing that settles nervous system.
records.description: Nervous System Calmer guides slow, research-based breathing exercises that help your body move from stress to calm. One tap on the circle starts a one-minute cyclic sigh. PLUS EDITION (one-time purchase, no subscription; try it in three free sessions) In a Stanford study (Balban et al., Cell Reports Medicine, 2023), five minutes of cyclic sighing a day improved mood and reduced physiological arousal more than mindfulness meditation.

records.name: Cliptrace
records.tagline: Saves what you copy on Windows and finds it by meaning
records.description: Cliptrace is a clipboard history for Windows that finds what you copied when you can only remember what it was about. You copy dozens of things a day and the Windows clipboard keeps almost none of it. Cliptrace saves your copies on your own PC and lets you describe one to get it back.

records.name: CoinWharf - AU Crypto Fee Comparison
records.tagline: Australian Crypto Exchange & Fee Comparison
records.description: CoinWharf.au is an independent Australian cryptocurrency comparison platform helping investors and everyday Australians understand the true cost of buying, selling and transferring digital assets. Rather than focusing solely on cryptocurrency prices, CoinWharf helps users compare Australian exchanges, trading fees, spreads, liquidity and withdrawal costs to make more informed decisions.

records.name: Crucible
records.tagline: A proving ground for AI agents
records.description: A proving ground for AI agents. Reputation is earned only from work that held up. Agents ship real work — with real money behind it. Crucible makes them stake a bond on every claim: bountied trials, paid challengers hunting for flaws, and one non-transferable record of what held up. Proof, not promises

records.name: Waya
records.tagline: AI loyalty program  to help SMEs get more customers
records.description: Digital loyalty program for small and medium businesses in Saudi Arabia. Apple Wallet and Google Wallet support, no app required.

records.name: Memory Bridge
records.tagline: One shared memory for ChatGPT, Claude, and your AI tools
records.description: Memory Bridge gives ChatGPT, Claude, and the other AI tools you connect one shared memory of your work. It turns project decisions, client preferences, and work context into editable notes you can review and reuse across tools.

records.name: DriftMap
records.tagline: Infer API contracts from JSON samples & block breaking PRs
records.description: Catch breaking JSON payload and OpenAPI changes before they merge. DriftMap infers live API contracts directly from raw JSON samples in a zero-upload IndexedDB workbench, classifies drift into 4 risk tiers (BREAKING, WARNING, SAFE, INFO), and gates pull requests in GitHub Actions with sticky diff reports and cloud baseline sync.

records.name: WappFlow
records.tagline: WhatsApp Automation & Campaign Software for Businesses
records.description: Manage WhatsApp campaigns smarter with WappFlow. Connect your WhatsApp, manage contacts, personalize messages, schedule campaigns and track performance from one dashboard.

records.name: GPM Pest Management
records.tagline: Termite Treatment
records.description: Punjab's best and most experienced pest control company • in the business since 1987. Certified anti-termite treatment with 2, 3 & 5 years written warranty, pre & post-construction chemical filling, termite pipe network installation, and odorless pest control annual AMC packages near me.

records.name: CreatLab
records.tagline: A personal AI agent team that works while you sleep
records.description: CreatLab gives you a personal team of AI agents that work together instead of one chatbot. At the centre is OVI (Operational Virtual Intelligence), your lead agent. You tell OVI what you need, and it hands the work to specialist agents you create, each with its own role, voice and apps. Your agents can: read your mail and check your calendar use connected apps like Notion, Slack, Google Drive and HubSpot run daily automations like a morning brief work on longer projects step by step

records.name: Nibble
records.tagline: React and Next.js components for you and your AI assistant
records.description: Build interfaces without starting from scratch. Nibble is a React and Next.js component library for developers who want to turn ideas into working interfaces faster. Explore interactive components, preview them, and copy their source code into your project. Connect your AI assistant through MCP to search the component library and retrieve code directly within your workflow.

records.name: TGMini
records.tagline: Build a mini site behind a button in your Telegram channel
records.description: TGMini puts a mini site behind a Menu button in your pinned Telegram post. Arrange links, image cards, text and video blocks in any order. Readers open your page inside Telegram or on the web. On a paid site, they can send you a message; you can reply right in the bot. Track visits and link clicks in your dashboard. Start with a free site, then upgrade for more links and reader messages.

records.name: Suprlative
records.tagline: every robot failure, turned into a verified fix
records.description: Every robot failure found, the repeats grouped and ranked by cost, and each fix verified. Book a 30-minute call.

records.name: Cognition SWE-2 Flash
records.tagline: Cognition’s fast coding model, 3x the speed of SWE-2
records.description: SWE-2 Flash is Cognition’s new coding model, built on Thinking Machines’ Inkling-Small with 276B total and 12B active parameters. Per Cognition, it generates about 200 tokens per second, 3x the speed of SWE-2 at one-fifth the price, and scores 20.0% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, up from 0.9% for the base model. Try it in Devin Desktop and Devin CLI, free through 11/30. Weights are not public yet.

records.name: Van-Goh
records.tagline: Product demos and motion graphics from one prompt
records.description: Van-Goh is an AI video studio for founders. Write one line about your product, add photos, screenshots or your own clip, and get back a finished product demo, a motion graphics launch film, or a premium edit of your footage. No editor or motion designer needed.

records.name: AON - Agent Offer Network
records.tagline: Structured merchant offers for AI apps and agents
records.description: AON connects AI apps, agents and websites with merchant offers matched to user intent. Integrate via REST API, TypeScript SDK or MCP, or embed Content Assistant. Free publisher integration, with commissions on qualifying outcomes.

records.name: GPT Realtime Assistant
records.tagline: Live voice AI, translation and transcripts on Apple devices
records.description: GPT Realtime Assistant is an independent app by Arte Soft for iPhone, iPad and Mac, not an OpenAI product. Use live voice conversations, two-way spoken translation, transcripts and screenshot context. Apple Silicon Macs can run downloaded speech and text models locally with an active subscription. Cloud AI features require internet access.

records.name: NEXORA
records.tagline: Private, direct device-to-device file sharing
records.description: NEXORA is an open-source file-sharing application that lets you transfer files directly between devices on your local network. No mandatory account or cloud storage required. Built with privacy and simplicity in mind, NEXORA is currently available for Windows 10/11 (64-bit)

records.name: Solana MLM Software
records.tagline: Launch Smart Network Marketing with Solana MLM Software
records.description: Develop custom Solana MLM Software with advanced blockchain integration, smart contract development, automated commission distribution, secure wallet connectivity, referral management, real-time transaction tracking, and scalable MLM functionalities tailored to your business requirements.

records.name: Hyvra.app
records.tagline: Your hypertrophy workouts, written and explained
records.description: Hyvra.app writes every lifting session from your split, your equipment and the muscles you want to grow: exercises, order, sets, target effort (RPE), tempo, rest. Then it sets your next load from what you actually did. French only for now.

records.name: SOMA
records.tagline: A two-minute somatic pause between meetings
records.description: Between meetings or after hours of screen time, choose how you feel, draw one of eight guided cards, and take a two-minute pause with gentle breathing, movement, or grounding. SOMA is free in your browser with no account or subscription. Your saved practices stay on this device, and there are no streaks to keep up with.

records.name: Canvas Quiz Solver
records.tagline: AI powered assistance for Canvas quizzes
records.description: AI answers and explanations for Classic and New Quizzes. Auto Answer, screenshots, picture choices and Solve All, right on your Canvas page.

records.name: My Budget Tracker: Shared
records.tagline: Shared budget tracker for couples, families & companies
records.description: Budget together with My Budget Tracker, the shared budget app and expense tracker for couples, families and roommates. Set monthly limits by category, add expenses in seconds, and share one household budget with an invite link or code. No bank linking needed. Set how much funds this budget for the period, split it into categories, and see what you plan to save. When the period closes, see what you actually kept. Prefer the classic way? Leave it blank.

records.name: Smart Tether
records.tagline: Use your Android phone's mobile data on Windows, no hotspot
records.description: Smart Tether lets your Windows PC use your Android phone's mobile data over USB or Wi-Fi, with the phone's hotspot and USB tethering left off. Unplug the cable and it switches to Wi-Fi without dropping open connections, so calls and games keep going. A tray icon shows how you're connected. Pair once by QR code. No account, no telemetry. Free and open source (MIT).

records.name: ClearChaine
records.tagline: Instant AML checks and risk scoring for crypto wallets.
records.description: One malicious contract interaction can drain a Web3 wallet. ClearChain provides instant risk intelligence for EVM-compatible addresses before you sign anything. Just paste an address to get: • Instant EVM validation • Risk surface assessment • Actionable security reports

records.name: Loop Frame Agency
records.tagline: SaaS explainer videos that make complex products clear
records.description: Loop Frame Agency creates explainer videos, product demos, and motion graphics for SaaS, AI, and fintech teams. We help turn complex products into clear stories for launches, websites, and marketing campaigns.

records.name: R3X Chat
records.tagline: R3X Chat is a futuristic AI assistant for writing, learning
records.description: Ask R3X anything — ideas, explanations, writing, code. Free daily usage, premium unlimited pass.

records.name: Grey: Grayscale & Website Color Filter
records.tagline: Grey turns distracting websites grayscale to help you focus.
records.description: Grey is a Firefox extension for students, remote workers, and anyone who wants fewer distractions online. It turns distracting websites grayscale, making colorful feeds less tempting while keeping useful content accessible. Key features: - Custom website filter and ignore lists - Adjustable color reduction and gradual Slow Fade - Item Safe Zones for keeping selected content in color - Five-minute breaks and a global pause toggle

records.name: QR Code Generator
records.tagline: Create a static QR code for any URL, text, email
records.description: Create a static QR code for any URL, text, email, phone number, or Wi-Fi login. Customize the size and color, then download as a high-quality PNG. Runs entirely in your browser — nothing is sent to a server, and no account is required.

records.name: AetherellWeb
records.tagline: Basically the internet but all over again
records.description: This web project is only for fun, it doesn't "solve" anything. I hope you like it, merry early christmas

records.name: HotLive
records.tagline: Panduan HotLive untuk membaca informasi unduhan
records.description: Portal HotLive di task789.com memuat panduan membaca informasi unduhan dan kebutuhan perangkat untuk pembaca Indonesia. Ini adalah situs panduan informasi, bukan pengembang aplikasi.

records.name: iBigStudio
records.tagline: Free converter. Image, Audio and Ocr
records.description: Free online converter for image formats (PNG, JPG, WEBP, AVIF, BMP, ICO) and audio formats (WAV, MP3, FLAC, AIFF, OGG), with whole-folder conversion (up to 100 files) and OCR text extraction from images and PDFs (up to 60 pages). Runs 100% in the browser; files are never uploaded.

records.name: Seven Lift General Transport L.L.C.
records.tagline: Forklifts, mobile cranes, telehandlers, and man lifts.
records.description: Seven Lift General Transport provides forklift, mobile crane, telehandler, and man lift rental across the UAE, with dedicated coverage in Abu Dhabi (Musaffah, ICAD, KIZAD) and Dubai (JAFZA, Al Quoz, Dubai Industrial City). Certified operators, flexible terms, 24/7 emergency deployment.

records.name: AIEST Desktop AI Launcher
records.tagline: Developer Tools AI Artificial Intelligence Local LLM Utility
records.description: AIEST is a lightweight desktop launcher for running local AI engines like Ollama, llama.cpp, and MLX-LM in the background without the overhead of heavy chat interfaces. Built with Tauri 2.0 and Rust, it's designed for developers who want direct, programmatic access to AI models.

records.name: RarePick Guides
records.tagline: Independent Krillion hints, answers and archives
records.description: An independent Krillion companion with progressive hints, selected answer records and source-linked explanations. Reveal help one question at a time, browse collected guides, or compare related games. No login required. Not affiliated with Krillion.

records.name: QuickNote
records.tagline: A social home for movie and book lovers
records.description: Log and rate movies and books, write short notes and reviews, and follow people whose taste you trust. Explore cast details and community reviews, and get picks based on your ratings. Free to join, with optional Premium.

records.name: AnyCode
records.tagline: One workspace for Claude Code, Codex and open models
records.description: A free, open-source desktop workspace for coding agents. Run Claude Code and Codex with your own accounts, or connect open models to the Native agent loop. Follow sessions, handle permission requests, preview changes and review Git diffs. Apache-2.0. Currently alpha, with unsigned builds. Model access is provided by your own accounts or connections.

records.name: Backpacking Is Life eSIM Calculator
records.tagline: Compare one regional eSIM with a plan for each stop
records.description: Planning a trip across borders? Enter your stops, days and typical data use to see what mobile data would cost for the whole route. Compare a single eSIM with a combination of plans, including their data limits, validity and prices in USD. Free to use, no signup.

records.name: Claimr
records.tagline: A free giveaways alert system
records.description: Free game radar and instant giveaway alert system tracking Steam, Epic Games, GOG, Prime Gaming, PlayStation, and Xbox.

records.name: ArchFlow
records.tagline: Open-source AI architect: from requirements to code
records.description: ArchFlow is an open-source, self-hosted AI system architect. Import a PRD or meeting transcript and get traceable requirements, AI-proposed architectures you compare and record as ADRs, and low-level designs for every component: APIs, tables, events and diagrams. Check health, cost and compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS), then generate Terraform, Kubernetes, tests and specs, and hand the design to Claude Code and other agents over MCP. Your team edits it live, with branches and reviews.

records.name: Nudge
records.tagline: AI chat widget for answers from your business documents
records.description: An AI chat widget that answers customer questions from your own documents.

records.name: QR Lasts
records.tagline: Free QR Code Generator
records.description: Make a free QR code and short link in seconds. 10 editable codes with a free account, fixed codes with no account, no trial and no ad page before your link.

records.name: Product Hunt MCP
records.tagline: The community you trust in the assistant you use
records.description: Ask your AI assistant to find your next favorite product. Explore new launches, compare alternatives, and see what the Product Hunt community thinks. Building something yourself? Turn your README and website into a launch draft, add images, and check what's missing before you submit. Sign in with Product Hunt to connect. No API key needed.

records.name: Cucimoo
records.tagline: POS and business app for car & motorcycle wash owners
records.description: Cucimoo is a point-of-sale and business management app for car and motorcycle wash owners in Indonesia. Record a wash in seconds, tag the staff who handled it, print receipts on Bluetooth/USB thermal printers, track expenses and shifts, run loyalty stamp cards, and see daily, weekly and monthly revenue and profit per branch. Web + Android. Free plan for one branch; Premium IDR 29,000/month with a 14-day free trial.
